backstage.description: - The standalone chart's extras ------------------------------------------- The components the agent-platform-standalone umbrella carried as Helm dependencies on top of the fleet's roster: Backstage, mcp-kubernetes, the CloudNativePG operator and the KServe charts. Off by default: a management cluster runs each of them as its own app and keeps them off here, so the fleet render is unchanged; a cluster that has none of them turns them on from this roster (the quick-start values). None of the seven ships CRDs in a crds/ dir — kserve-crd, kserve-llmisvc-crd and cloudnative-pg render their CRDs as templates, upgraded with the release and annotated helm.sh/resource-policy: keep — so no `crds:` policy applies to them; the CRD-before-CR order is dependsOn. Their values blocks (backstage:, mcp-kubernetes:, cloudnative-pg:, kserve-*:) carry the standalone's defaults; the wiring the standalone rendered by hand for them (the Backstage app-config ConfigMap and route, the mcp-kubernetes MCPServer CR, the model serving runtimes) is the connectivity chart's, gated on these same toggles, and arrives in a following release.

enabled.description: `auto` (default) renders the monitor objects when monitoring.coreos.com/v1 is served on the cluster, detected once by the meta chart (an offline `helm template` resolves to false unless the API is passed in); `true` / `false` force them on or off.

`auto` (default) renders the Kyverno objects when kyverno.io/v1 is served on the cluster, detected once by the meta chart (an offline `helm template` resolves to false unless the API is passed in); `true` / `false` force them on or off.

flavor.description: `auto` (default) selects `cilium` when cilium.io/v2 is served on the cluster and `kubernetes` otherwise; `cilium` / `kubernetes` force the flavor.
